notes: All 249 images C000-C248 were visually inspected on all nine contact sheets with original boxes. Full-size images were inspected only where full_size_review is true. This is a conservative visual screen, not proof of complete pixel-level annotation correctness.

Accept means no clear missing target or gross box/class error was found at the reviewed resolution. Quarantine includes both confirmed missing furniture labels and explicitly stated unresolved edge/doorway ambiguities; these must not all be counted as confirmed annotation errors.

No clear gross Chair-class mismatch or badly misplaced main-chair box was found among the accepted images. C057 was checked at full size and its apparent short box on the thumbnail actually encompasses the legs. Image-edge truncation of a target was not rejected when the visible extent was reasonably boxed.

group_id preserves visually repeated object/viewpoint families, including noncontiguous IDs. Product pairs C061/C212 and C222/C224 show repeated product imagery. C073/C074, C125/C126 and C201/C202 are conservatively grouped closely matching product variants. Unrelated or uncertain product identities retain unique IDs; computed duplicate groups may further merge them.
